sourceMessage: For the ones, the 19 that are completed runs and earlier engine versions, just rerun them again. 19 doesn't really matter, just rerun those. This main thing to fix is the 16 that have proceed or patrol failures. That's something that you may need to check in the way the engine works. That's causing this problem. Maybe you can change the seed or something. Just get it, you know, get some kind of a result. That's what matters.
interpretation: Explicit exception permits rerunning the 19 older-engine projections under the repaired engine.
